content: I hope you received enough feedback from the community to improve your contribution. Once you have made the necessary updates, publish your contribution!
this is lowkey challenging for a simple clash

Constraints
* Please change 10^18 to 10^15, as [[N]] never exceeds 10^15.

Cases
* Each test and its validator should cover the same scenario, but with slightly different inputs and outputs. Hence:

  • Validator 2: Please change 99 to 8 so that [[N]] is also a single-digit integer, similar to Test 2.

  • Validator 3: Please change 44444 to 700000 so that [[N]] also contains a single non-zero digit only, similar to Test 3.

  • Validator 4: Please change 900000000000000 to another [[N]] in which all digits are 9, similar to Test 4.

* Please also add a pair of new cases where [[N]] is a random number with some digits appearing more than once, e.g. 730227182.

Thanks.

Note: Several existing clashes require calculating the digital root:

https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/81598220e99b466216bf8ee272d73fc475ac
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/6133a2ed289ce33ad363c65aa5c168ddb7a8
https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/133cc5483002893a492e9f431ab7fbc4b23

However, none of them requires determining the number of reduction steps, so this new clash can be treated as unique.
I at first thought that it was overly simple, but there is enough meat for a clash.
is it though? i really think that i can make it MUCH harder... it's just that it's my season for GCSE and rn im revising so im literally braindead half the time and can't make another 10 test cases
I don't think so: a simple while loop with a counter is enough to solve the problem. That said, it’s certainly more difficult than simply multiplying length by width...

Constraints
* Please format "N" as a [[variable]].

Cases
* Without modifying the existing cases, please add a new pair of cases:
  - random integer
  - 7 or more digits
  - number of reduction steps = 3

  One way to construct such an integer:
  1. Start with a base number [[A]]
    • It should have more than 2 digits
    • Its digit sum must be a two-digit multiple of 9

  2. Modify the number
    • Insert additional digits anywhere within [[A]]
    • Ensure the new digit sum:
      (a) is greater than the original sum, and
      (b) does not exceed the next multiple of 10

  Example:
  1. Set [[A]] = 583938 (digit sum = 36)
  
  2. Insert 0 and 2 = 5_02_83938_0 i.e. 502839380
  
  Verify:
  - 5 + 0 + 2 + 8 + 3 + 9 + 3 + 8 + 0 = 38
  - 3 + 8 = 11
  - 1 + 1 = 2 (3 steps)

Thanks.

Stub generator
* Please change "write steps" to "steps".

After that, you may consider switching the state of the contribution as Ready.
